This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the Japanese [[Generation I|first generation]] game [[Pokémon Blue Version (Japanese)|Pokémon Blue Version]] for the [[Game Boy]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Game Freak]] and [[Creatures, Inc.]]
